source.check: Returning Officer's notice of the result, Londonderry Sentinel 7 Jun 1967 p17 (page image read; also Derry Journal 6 Jun 1967 p7): duly elected; no poll in this division.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Middle Liberties was the only contested seat on the council; all other members were returned unopposed and their names were not printed in the reports used here. The other twelve divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Londonderry Sentinel, 7 June 1967, p. 17; Derry Journal, 6 June 1967, p. 7) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
